run.replayAssertions: cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && FI_REPLAY_DIR=$PWD/failure_injection/evidence/fi-v1-full deno test -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection.test.ts
run.replayOneScenario: cd supabase/functions/api/__wf__ && FI_ONLY='<scenario id>' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts

findings.title: Supabase Auth outage (5xx / network / malformed body) is reported to the app as a sign-out 401 instead of a retryable 503
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='matrix:me:auth:down_503,matrix:shots_sync:auth:network_error,matrix:account_bootstrap_google:auth:down_503' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: 262/262 authenticated + bootstrap scenarios with Auth returning 500/502/503, a connect error, malformed JSON, wrong-shape JSON or an empty body answer HTTP 401 'The session is no longer valid. Sign in again.' / 'The identity token could not be verified.' — the class the mobile client treats as terminal (handleApiUnauthorized → refresh → sign-out when refresh also fails).
findings.expected: Auth transport/5xx failures → generic 503 (serviceUnavailable) so the app retries; only a definitive token rejection (401/403 from Auth) should be a 401.

findings.title: POST /v1/auth/refresh: Auth network error / malformed or empty body → 401 (only an HTTP status >= 500 maps to 503)
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='matrix:auth_refresh:auth:network_error,matrix:auth_refresh:auth:malformed_json,matrix:auth_refresh:auth:empty_body' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: network_error / malformed_json / wrong_shape / empty_body → 401 'The session could not be refreshed. Sign in again.' (refreshed.error.status is undefined for these, so the >= 500 branch is skipped). This is the ONE implicit sign-out path the AGENTS.md contract reserves for a refused refresh token.
findings.expected: 503 for anything that is not an explicit 401/403 refresh-token rejection.

findings.title: An Auth outage trips the per-IP auth-failure lockout: once Auth recovers, the IP gets 429 for up to 5 minutes
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='targeted:me:recovers_after_30_outage_calls,targeted:auth_refresh:refresh_after_30_outage_calls,targeted:account_bootstrap_google:bootstrap_after_30_outage_calls' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: 30 requests during an Auth 503 outage from one IP → 30×401 (each counted as an auth failure); the first request after Auth is healthy again → 429 (verdict locked_out) on /v1/me, /v1/auth/refresh and /v1/account/bootstrap.
findings.expected: Outage responses must not count against AUTH_FAILURE_LIMIT; the first healthy request after recovery → 200.

findings.title: POST /v1/auth/logout: a network error on the raw fetch to /auth/v1/logout is uncaught → generic 500
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='targeted:auth_logout:logout_call_network_error' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: 500 'Something went wrong. Please try again.' (body generic, no leak; the TypeError is logged server-side).
findings.expected: 503 via serviceUnavailable('Sign-out', …) like the >= 500 branch two lines below.

findings.title: No upstream timeout on Supabase Auth / PostgREST calls: a hung upstream hangs the route past every mobile client timeout
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='matrix:me:auth:hang,matrix:shots_sync:rest:hang' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: 57 auth/rest hang scenarios still unresolved at the 25 s harness budget (mobile gives up at 15–20 s), while Redis (1.2 s) and RevenueCat (10 s) hangs are bounded.
findings.expected: Bounded upstream wait (AbortSignal.timeout on the client fetch) → 503 within the client's timeout.

findings.title: RevenueCat webhook: DB failure while persisting a verified verdict is acknowledged with 200 {received:true, verified:false} — RevenueCat never retries, entitlement row stays stale
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='targeted:webhook_revenuecat:entitlement_persist_500,matrix:webhook_revenuecat:rest:down_503' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: billing_entitlements upsert returns 500/502/503/network error/malformed body → route answers 200 (8 false_success records). The code comment documents acknowledging a missing-profile FK failure on purpose, but the same branch swallows transient DB outages.
findings.expected: 503 so RevenueCat retries the event (the verification-failure branch already does this).

findings.title: Array-typed PostgREST reads assume an array: a 2xx object body throws → generic 500 (low realism: only if PostgREST/gateway returns 2xx with a non-array JSON body)
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='matrix:progress:rest:wrong_shape,matrix:shots_sync:rest:wrong_shape,matrix:consent_status:rest:wrong_shape' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: 10 routes → 500 (TypeError: rows.filter is not a function / (existing.data ?? []).map is not a function / Spread syntax requires iterable). Body is the generic 500; no leak.
findings.expected: 503 (treat a non-array `data` as an upstream error).

findings.title: POST /v1/auth/refresh during an Auth 5xx outage is held ~25 s by auth-js retry backoff — longer than the app's 15 s refresh timeout
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='matrix:auth_refresh:auth:down_503,matrix:auth_refresh:auth:error_500' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: 503 after 25.4 s (auth-js retries 5xx with exponential backoff); the client has already timed out, so the eventual correct 503 is never seen.
findings.expected: Answer within the client budget (bounded retries or a fetch timeout).

findings.title: Hung Upstash Redis costs every authenticated request 5–7 serial 1.2 s timeouts (6–8.4 s added latency, no circuit breaker)
findings.repro: FI_ONLY='matrix:me:redis:hang,matrix:progress:redis:hang' FI_TIER=full FI_SEED=fi-v1 deno run -A --no-check --config deno.json failure_injection/fiRunner.ts
findings.observed: 27 redis:hang scenarios answer with the baseline status (fail-open works) but take 6.0–8.4 s (5–7 sequential Redis calls each waiting the full 1.2 s).
findings.expected: After the first timeout, short-circuit Redis for the rest of the request (or a short-lived isolate-level breaker) so a Redis hang adds ≤ 1.2 s.

verifiedOk: Redis down/HTTP error/malformed/slow/hang: every route keeps its baseline status (memory fallback; no lockout)
PostgREST/RPC 5xx on non-webhook routes: generic 503 or per-item retryable rejection envelope (shots_sync, evaluation_trials); no false 2xx
RevenueCat down/slow/malformed on billing sync: coded 502 billing_unavailable / 503; hang bounded at 10 s
Apple exchange/revoke 5xx/network/invalid_grant on deletion: 503 (status-only calls, malformed 2xx body correctly treated as success)
Webhook: RevenueCat verification failure → 503 (provider retries); anonymous-only events → 200 without lookup
No Storage call reachable from any route (storageCalls=0 on all 35 baselines)
